```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(wfmR)
library(ggplot2)
wfm_chart_defaults(base_size = 18)

category_df <- data.frame(
  group = factor(
    tools::toTitleCase(names(wfm_palette())),
    levels = tools::toTitleCase(names(wfm_palette()))
  ),
  value = c(31, 27, 24, 21, 18, 16, 13)
)

volcano_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(volcano))
names(volcano_df) <- c("x", "y", "height")
volcano_df <- transform(
  volcano_df,
  x = as.integer(x),
  y = as.integer(y),
  signal = height - mean(height)
)

mtcars_cyl <- transform(mtcars, cyl = factor(cyl))
```

## Text Styles

The revealjs theme translates the HTML palette into a presentation setting:
system UI type, restrained headings, Rose Pine links, and shared chart metadata.

[Salmon]{.label-salmon}, [teal]{.label-teal}, [purple]{.label-purple}, and
[lime]{.label-lime} use the same generic coloured labels as the article
theme.

::: {.small-disclaimer}
Slides use larger chart text and transparent SVG output so figures remain
crisp when projected.
:::

## Code Style

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
category_df |>
  ggplot(aes(group, value, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  scale_fill_wfm() +
  scale_y_wfm(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, subtitle = "Value") +
  theme_wfm()
```

## Salmon {.section-salmon}

Warm emphasis for motivation, takeaways, and section breaks.

## Teal {.section-teal}

Calm evidence sections with a soft analytical tone.

## Purple {.section-purple}

Conceptual framing, methods, and transitions between arguments.

## Lime {.section-lime}

Supporting structure for design notes and secondary findings.

## Yellow {.section-yellow}

Attention moments for caveats, contrasts, and important pivots.

## Blue {.section-blue}

Grounded analytical sections for results and interpretation.

## Pink {.section-pink}

Closing sections, discussion, and synthesis.

## Primary Palette

```{r}
#| label: fig-slide-palette
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3.3
palette_df <- data.frame(
  colour = factor(names(wfm_palette()), levels = names(wfm_palette())),
  value = unname(wfm_palette())
)

ggplot(palette_df, aes(colour, 1, fill = colour)) +
  geom_tile(height = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = value), y = 1, size = 4.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wfm_palette()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_wfm(grid = FALSE) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Categorical Chart

```{r}
#| label: fig-slide-bars
#| chart-title: "Seven categories use the primary order"
#| chart-subtitle: "The bar chart exercises every default colour"
#| chart-notes: "Use direct labels or another aesthetic when dense categories carry analytical weight."
#| chart-source: "Illustrative data."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.8
category_df |>
  ggplot(aes(group, value, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  scale_fill_wfm() +
  scale_y_wfm(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, subtitle = "Value") +
  theme_wfm() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Sequential Scale

```{r}
#| label: fig-slide-seq
#| chart-title: "Sequential colour follows ordered intensity"
#| chart-subtitle: "Blue, teal, and pale yellow are interpolated in OKLab"
#| chart-notes: "This is the default sequential palette."
#| chart-source: "R datasets package."
#| fig-width: 8.8
#| fig-height: 4.8
ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x, y, fill = height)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_wfm_seq(palette = "blue_teal_yellow", name = "Height") +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_wfm(grid = FALSE) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## Diverging Scale

```{r}
#| label: fig-slide-div
#| chart-title: "Diverging colour marks distance from a midpoint"
#| chart-subtitle: "Teal and salmon sit either side of neutral"
#| chart-notes: "The midpoint is set to zero."
#| chart-source: "R datasets package."
#| fig-width: 8.8
#| fig-height: 4.8
ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x, y, fill = signal)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_wfm_div(palette = "teal_salmon", midpoint = 0, name = "Signal") +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_wfm(grid = FALSE) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## Table and Chart

```{r}
#| label: fig-slide-boxplot
#| chart-title: "Fuel economy by engine size"
#| chart-subtitle: "Boxplot using the wfmR fill scale"
#| chart-notes: "Colours come from the package palette."
#| chart-source: "R datasets package."
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 4.6
mtcars_cyl |>
  ggplot(aes(cyl, mpg, fill = cyl)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.62, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_wfm() +
  labs(x = "Cylinders", y = "Miles per gallon")
```

## Compact Table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-slide-summary
summary_df <- aggregate(
  mpg ~ cyl,
  mtcars_cyl,
  function(x) sprintf("%.1f", mean(x))
)
names(summary_df) <- c("Cylinders", "Mean miles per gallon")
knitr::kable(summary_df, align = c("l", "r"))
```
